question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. D sits to the immediate left of F. Only six people sit between S and D. K sits third to the right of F. S sits at the extreme left end of the row. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
**Given**: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. 

1) D sits to the immediate left of F. 

2)Only six people sit between S and D.

3) K sits third to the right of F. 

4) S sits at the extreme left end of the row.

**CASE 2:**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0d681b470492ecd409a5919f09b4069109828afc8c459fb589b66cfe68e9291.png] 

As it is given that S sits at the extreme left end,** so CASE 1 gets eliminated and we have the final arrangement in CASE 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0d681b470492ecd409a5919f09b4069109828afc8c459fb589b66cfe68e9291.png] 

So, **12 persons are seated in a row.**

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
